instruction: Please show me how to apply a custom workspace color theme using an image file from Downloads to tint the VS Code interface.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in functionality to generate color themes from image files. While background extensions exist, they are not part of the standard VS Code installation and their behavior cannot be reliably evaluated through state-based checks.
metadata.infeasible_reason: Image-based theme generation is not a native VS Code feature and requires third-party extensions

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - VS Code does not have native functionality to generate or apply color themes from image files
The infeasible designation is semantically correct because the instruction requires image-to-theme conversion which is not a built-in VS Code feature
Standard VS Code only supports: (1) built-in themes, (2) JSON-based custom themes, (3) marketplace extension themes - none of which involve generating themes from image files
No reliable state-based verification possible for non-existent functionality
The infeasible_reason correctly identifies that this would require third-party extensions whose behavior cannot be reliably evaluated
